meta.name: triage
meta.description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles, categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分诊问题与外部PR，生成可执行的任务简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在维护开源项目，常被大量Issue和外部PR淹没，需要快速分诊归类。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain an open-source project and need a fast way to sort incoming issues and external PRs.

howto.what: Claude 会把 issue 和外部 PR 放进一套分诊状态里推进:归为 bug 或 enhancement、核实问题是否复现、必要时逐条盘问,并写出可直接交给 agent 执行的简报。它发出的每条留言开头都会标注「AI 生成」。
howto.when: 由维护者手动输入 /triage 并用自然语言说明想做什么时接管(该技能禁用模型自动调用)。常见说法包括「看看有什么需要我处理的」、「我们看下 #42」等。

say.text: 看看有什么需要我处理的
say.note: 按未标注、needs-triage、待回复分三桶列出
读全量上下文并给出分类与状态建议
直接应用角色,跳过盘问

howto.what_en: Claude moves issues and external PRs through triage: categorises them as bug or enhancement, verifies the claim, grills when needed, and posts agent-ready briefs. Every comment it posts starts with an AI-generated disclaimer.
howto.when_en: Invoked when the maintainer runs /triage and describes what they want in natural language; the skill disables model invocation, so it is not triggered automatically.

say_en.text: Show me anything that needs my attention
say_en.note: Lists unlabeled, needs-triage and needs-info buckets
Reads full context and recommends a category and state
Applies the role directly, skipping grilling
